- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The first Olympic Games were held in 776 BC in Olympia, Greece, as a religious festival honoring Zeus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The events of the ancient Olympic Games included the "pentathlon," which comprised running, jumping, wrestling, and throwing a discus and javelin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ancient Olympic Games continued until 393 AD when Emperor Theodosius I banned them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The modern Olympic Games began in 1896 in Athens, Greece, and have continued every four years, with interruptions due to World War I and II.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Women's events were introduced in 1900, and new sports like snowboarding and BMX have been added in recent years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Olympics have become a platform for political and social issues, citing the 1968 Games in Mexico City and the 2014 Sochi Games as examples.
